newsitem.title: USA: PG&E trims Diablo Canyon nuclear 2 output.
newsitem.headline: PG&E trims Diablo Canyon nuclear 2 output.

text.p: Pacific Gas & Electric Co (PG&E) said it trimmed output at its 1,073 megawatt (MW) Diablo Canyon 2 nuclear power unit this weekend to 82 percent of capacity, due to what it called a "light system load."
The adjoining 1,087 MW unit 1, at Avila Beach on the central California coast, was operating at 100 percent power, the company said.
The company did not indicate whether loads Monday would likely be sufficient to merit increasing the unit's output.
The Diablo Canyon facility accounts for 16.6 percent of PG&E's total generation capacity.
San Francisco-based Pacific Gas & Electric is a subsidiary of PG&E Corp.
